name: list_events_for_day
description: List all events on a specific calendar day, including ones that have already started or ended. Use this instead of list_events when the user asks about a specific day (e.g. 'today', 'tomorrow', a specific date) rather than what's coming up next.

date.description: The day to list events for, as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today, in the calendar's own timezone, if omitted.

calendar_id.description: Which calendar to list events from. Defaults to the configured calendar_id. Use list_calendars to see available IDs.
